## What this does

Pulls breakfast and lunch menus from the [MealViewer](https://www.mealviewer.com) API for a given school, writes them to a `.ics` calendar file, and optionally pushes the events straight into Google Calendar via the Calendar API.

The default behavior is **"give me everything from today through whatever future menus MealViewer has published."** No manual date ranges, no clicking through school websites.

### Pipeline

```         
MealViewer API  ──▶  tibble of menu items  ──▶  one event per (date, meal)
                                                       │
                                  ┌────────────────────┴────────────────────┐
                                  ▼                                         ▼
                            fallsmead_menus.ics                    Google Calendar API
                            (backup / manual import)                (direct push, idempotent)
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

# Install (one-time):
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "httr2", "lubridate", "googleAuthR", "cli"))

library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(lubridate)
library(googleAuthR)
library(cli)
```

### Configuration

Change `SCHOOL_KEY` to point at a different school. Find your school's key by visiting `mealviewer.com`, searching for the school, and copying the slug from the URL (e.g. `https://schools.mealviewer.com/school/FallsmeadES` → `FallsmeadES`).

```{r}
#| label: config

SCHOOL_KEY  <- "FallsmeadES"
SCHOOL_NAME <- "Fallsmead ES"
BASE_URL    <- "https://api.mealviewer.com/api/v4/school"

# How far ahead to ask MealViewer for menus. The API silently returns whatever
# subset of this window it actually has data for, so being generous is free.
LOOKAHEAD_DAYS <- 60

# Where the calendar lands. Relative to the .qmd file when rendered, or to
# getwd() when run interactively chunk-by-chunk.
OUTPUT_ICS <- "fallsmead_menus.ics"
```

## Step 1 — Fetch from MealViewer

MealViewer's API takes a school key and a date range formatted `MM-DD-YYYY`. We chunk requests into 30-day windows to be polite and to avoid any quiet truncation on the server side.

```{r}
#| label: fetch-functions

fetch_menu_chunk <- function(school_key, start_date, end_date) {
  url <- str_glue(
    "{BASE_URL}/{school_key}/",
    "{format(start_date, '%m-%d-%Y')}/{format(end_date, '%m-%d-%Y')}/"
  )

  cli_alert_info("Fetching {format(start_date)} → {format(end_date)}")

  resp <- tryCatch(
    request(url) |>
      req_headers(
        "Accept"     = "application/json",
        "User-Agent" = "lunchline/0.1 (R; tidyverse)"
      ) |>
      req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = \(i) 2^i) |>
      req_perform(),
    error = function(e) {
      cli_alert_danger("Request failed: {e$message}")
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(resp) || resp_status(resp) != 200) return(NULL)
  resp_body_json(resp)
}
```

Parsing is verbose because MealViewer nests its data four levels deep (`menuSchedules → menuBlocks → cafeteriaLineList → foodItemList`). We flatten it into one row per food item.

```{r}
#| label: parse-functions

# Parse one date from MealViewer's `dateInformation` block.
# It exposes both `dateFull` ("2026-04-07T00:00:00") and `dateKey` (20260407).
# We try both because individual schools sometimes omit one or the other.
parse_menu_date <- function(date_info) {
  if (!is.null(date_info$dateFull) && nchar(date_info$dateFull) > 0) {
    d <- suppressWarnings(as_date(ymd_hms(date_info$dateFull)))
    if (!is.na(d)) return(d)
  }
  if (!is.null(date_info$dateKey)) {
    d <- suppressWarnings(ymd(as.character(date_info$dateKey)))
    if (!is.na(d)) return(d)
  }
  NA
}

parse_menu_response <- function(api_response) {
  if (is.null(api_response$menuSchedules) || length(api_response$menuSchedules) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  # walk the four-level nest with map_dfr at each layer
  api_response$menuSchedules |>
    map_dfr(function(schedule) {
      menu_date <- parse_menu_date(schedule$dateInformation)
      if (is.na(menu_date)) return(tibble())
      if (length(schedule$menuBlocks %||% list()) == 0) return(tibble())

      map_dfr(schedule$menuBlocks, function(block) {
        meal_type <- block$blockName
        lines <- block$cafeteriaLineList$data %||% list()

        map_dfr(lines, function(line) {
          items <- line$foodItemList$data %||% list()
          map_dfr(items, function(item) {
            tibble(
              date           = menu_date,
              meal_type      = meal_type,
              cafeteria_line = line$name %||% NA_character_,
              item_type      = item$item_Type %||% NA_character_,
              item_name      = item$item_Name %||% NA_character_
            )
          })
        })
      })
    })
}
```

The driver function: start at today, ask for `LOOKAHEAD_DAYS` worth of menus, chunk the requests, stitch the results together.

```{r}
#| label: scrape-driver

scrape_menus <- function(school_key = SCHOOL_KEY,
                         start_date = today(),
                         lookahead_days = LOOKAHEAD_DAYS,
                         chunk_days = 30) {

  end_date <- start_date + days(lookahead_days)
  cli_h2("Scraping {school_key}: {start_date} → {end_date}")

  windows <- tibble(
    chunk_start = seq(start_date, end_date, by = chunk_days)
  ) |>
    mutate(chunk_end = pmin(chunk_start + days(chunk_days - 1), end_date))

  windows |>
    pmap(function(chunk_start, chunk_end) {
      Sys.sleep(0.5) # rate-limit politeness
      fetch_menu_chunk(school_key, chunk_start, chunk_end) |>
        parse_menu_response()
    }) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    distinct() |>
    arrange(date, meal_type, cafeteria_line)
}
```

Run it:

```{r}
#| label: do-scrape

menus <- scrape_menus()

cli_alert_success("Got {nrow(menus)} menu items across {n_distinct(menus$date)} days")
```

Quick sanity peek:

```{r}
#| label: peek
menus |>
  count(date, meal_type) |>
  arrange(date) |>
  head(10)
```

## Step 2 — Collapse into one event per (date, meal)

Each `(date, meal_type)` becomes a single all-day event. We bucket items into entrees / vegetables / fruits / grains so the description reads cleanly, and pick the most distinctive entrees for the event title.

```{r}
#| label: shape-events

# These show up every single day and add no signal to the title.
# Still listed in the description, just not in the headline.
BORING_ITEMS <- c(
  "Grab N Go Yogurt & Granola",
  "Blueberry Chex Cereal",
  "Honey O's Cereal",
  "Banana Bread",
  "Mini Pancakes",
  "Maryland Made Cinnamon Roll",
  "Beef Sausage & Cheese WG Mini Bagel",
  "Beef & Cheese Spicy Taco",
  "Mini Cinnamon Cream Cheese Bagel",
  "Vanilla Belgian Waffle",
  "Grilled Cheese Sandwich",  # available daily as an alt at lunch
  "Craisins",
  "Apple Juice",
  "Orange Juice"
)

pick_headline_entrees <- function(entrees, n = 2) {
  if (length(entrees) == 0) return(character(0))
  interesting <- setdiff(entrees, BORING_ITEMS)
  if (length(interesting) == 0) interesting <- entrees
  head(unique(interesting), n)
}

events <- menus |>
  group_by(date, meal_type) |>
  summarize(
    entrees    = list(unique(item_name[item_type == "Entree"])),
    vegetables = list(unique(item_name[item_type == "Vegetable"])),
    fruits     = list(unique(item_name[item_type == "Fruit"])),
    grains     = list(unique(item_name[item_type == "Grain"])),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    headline    = map_chr(entrees, \(e) paste(pick_headline_entrees(e), collapse = " • ")),
    summary     = str_glue("{meal_type}: {headline}"),
    description = pmap_chr(
      list(entrees, vegetables, fruits, grains),
      function(e, v, f, g) {
        parts <- c(
          if (length(e) > 0) str_glue("ENTREES: {paste(e, collapse = ', ')}"),
          if (length(v) > 0) str_glue("VEGGIES: {paste(v, collapse = ', ')}"),
          if (length(f) > 0) str_glue("FRUIT: {paste(f, collapse = ', ')}"),
          if (length(g) > 0) str_glue("GRAINS: {paste(g, collapse = ', ')}")
        )
        paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
      }
    )
  ) |>
  select(date, meal_type, summary, description)

events |> select(date, meal_type, summary) |> head(6)
```

## Step 3 — Write the `.ics` file

Two things from the original script needed fixing:

1.  **Idempotent UIDs.** The old code used `Sys.time()` in the UID, so every re-scrape generated brand new UIDs and re-uploading the .ics created duplicate events. New scheme: `YYYYMMDD-meal@lunchline.local` — stable across runs, so re-imports update in place.
2.  **RFC 5545 escaping.** The old code stripped commas and semicolons to dodge the ICS format. The right fix is to escape them: `,` → `\,`, `;` → `\;`, `\` → `\\`, newlines → `\n`. Now item names render with their natural punctuation.

```{r}
#| label: ics-helpers

# RFC 5545 §3.3.11: escape \, ; , and newlines in TEXT values
escape_ics_text <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_replace_all("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\") |>  # backslash first
    str_replace_all(";",  "\\\\;") |>
    str_replace_all(",",  "\\\\,") |>
    str_replace_all("\n", "\\\\n")
}

# RFC 5545 §3.1: lines must not exceed 75 octets. Long lines get folded by
# inserting CRLF + a single space.
fold_ics_line <- function(line, width = 73) {
  if (nchar(line, type = "bytes") <= 75) return(line)
  segments <- character()
  remaining <- line
  first <- TRUE
  while (nchar(remaining, type = "bytes") > width) {
    seg <- substr(remaining, 1, width)
    segments <- c(segments, if (first) seg else paste0(" ", seg))
    remaining <- substr(remaining, width + 1, nchar(remaining))
    first <- FALSE
  }
  segments <- c(segments, paste0(" ", remaining))
  paste(segments, collapse = "\r\n")
}

build_ics <- function(events_df, school_name = SCHOOL_NAME) {
  dtstamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", tz = "UTC")

  event_blocks <- events_df |>
    mutate(
      date_str = format(date, "%Y%m%d"),
      dtend_str = format(date + days(1), "%Y%m%d"),  # all-day events are exclusive of end date
      uid = str_glue("{date_str}-{tolower(meal_type)}@lunchline.local"),
      block = pmap_chr(
        list(date_str, dtend_str, uid, summary, description),
        function(d, dend, u, s, desc) {
          lines <- c(
            "BEGIN:VEVENT",
            str_glue("UID:{u}"),
            str_glue("DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}"),
            str_glue("DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:{d}"),
            str_glue("DTEND;VALUE=DATE:{dend}"),
            fold_ics_line(str_glue("SUMMARY:{escape_ics_text(s)}")),
            fold_ics_line(str_glue("DESCRIPTION:{escape_ics_text(desc)}")),
            "TRANSP:TRANSPARENT",
            "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
            "END:VEVENT"
          )
          paste(lines, collapse = "\r\n")
        }
      )
    ) |>
    pull(block)

  header <- c(
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//lunchline//School Menus//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    str_glue("X-WR-CALNAME:{escape_ics_text(school_name)} Menus"),
    "X-WR-TIMEZONE:America/New_York"
  )

  paste(c(header, event_blocks, "END:VCALENDAR"), collapse = "\r\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: write-ics
ics_text <- build_ics(events)
writeLines(ics_text, OUTPUT_ICS, sep = "")
cli_alert_success("Wrote {nrow(events)} events to {OUTPUT_ICS}")
```
